title: MPS: put the latest changes on the hosted calculator?
bluf: Eighteen small changes have landed since the last hosted deploy on 16 November. Only one changes the live site: a saved place for quote templates, which you ruled on 16 November, with a warning if it is blank. The rest are tests and notes. All checks on main are green. The test login's secret was still expired on 16 November, so the three seller checks cannot run. Deploy now, without those three checks? One thing to know: the template setting goes on with an infrastructure apply, and that apply rewrites every app setting on the site, so it is part of this same yes.

options.label: Deploy now, without the three seller checks again
options.detail: Backup first. Run the infrastructure apply that sets the template place (it rewrites every app setting, so the settings are compared before and after), put the package on the site, check the files match, create one test template, restart, and see it listed. The one new warning sentence for operators goes as written. Every other check runs. Same rules as 16 November: roll forward only, stop if the start is refused or a check is unproven. The test login's secret stays yours to renew whenever you choose.

options.label: Wait until the test login's secret is renewed
options.detail: No deploy until you have done the renewal on the other card. Templates stay lost at each restart until then.

options.label: Do not deploy now
options.detail: Nothing changes. The template place stays unset and saved templates are lost at each restart.

default_action: Nothing is deployed. The template place stays unset. Tuesday asks again with the next batch of changes.
